source.text: כִּֽי־יַכְרִ֞ית יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ אֶת־אַרְצָ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֕ם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֥ בְעָרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְבָתֵּיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: When cuts off Yahweh your God the nations whose land Yahweh your God [is] giving to you, and you dispossess them and you dwell in their cities and in their houses,

en.L: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God cuts off the nations whose land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you, and you dispossess them and live in their cities and in their houses,
en.B: When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God has destroyed the nations whose land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you, and you have driven them out and settled in their towns and houses,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God will destroy the nations whose land {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is giving you. You will drive them out and live in their towns and houses. When that time comes,

es.L: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios extermine las naciones cuya tierra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da, y tú las desposeas y habites en sus ciudades y en sus casas,
es.B: Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios haya destruido las naciones cuya tierra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da, y tú las hayas expulsado y te hayas establecido en sus ciudades y casas,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios destruirá las naciones cuya tierra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te da. Tú las echarás y vivirás en sus ciudades y en sus casas. Cuando llegue ese momento,

fr.L: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu aura retranché les nations dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne le pays, et que tu les auras dépossédées et habiteras dans leurs villes et dans leurs maisons,
fr.B: Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu aura détruit les nations dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne le pays, que tu les auras chassées et que tu te seras installé dans leurs villes et leurs maisons,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu va détruire les nations dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te donne le pays. Tu vas les chasser et habiter dans leurs villes et leurs maisons. Quand ce moment sera venu,

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakapoyakatilia mbali mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa nchi yao, nawe ukayafukuza na kukaa katika miji yao na katika nyumba zao,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atakapokuwa ameyaangamiza mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa nchi yao, nawe ukiwa umeyafukuza na kuishi katika miji yao na nyumba zao,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako atayaangamiza mataifa ambayo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anakupa nchi yao. Utayafukuza na kuishi katika miji yao na nyumba zao. Wakati huo utakapofika,

vi.L: Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi diệt trừ các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đang ban xứ của chúng cho ngươi, và ngươi đuổi chúng đi và sống trong các thành và trong các nhà của chúng,
vi.B: Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đã tiêu diệt các dân tộc có xứ mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang ban cho anh em, và anh em đã đuổi họ đi, định cư trong các thành và nhà cửa của họ,
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ tiêu diệt các dân tộc có xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang ban cho anh em. Anh em sẽ đuổi họ đi và sống trong các thành và nhà cửa của họ. Đến lúc ấy,

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님이 너에게 주시는 땅의 민족들을 끊어 버리시고, 네가 그들을 쫓아내고 그들의 성읍들과 그들의 집들에서 살게 될 때에,
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서 너희에게 그 땅을 주시려고 그 민족들을 멸망시키시고, 너희가 그들을 쫓아내고 그들의 성읍과 집에 자리 잡고 살게 되면,
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서 그 민족들을 멸망시키시고 그들의 땅을 여러분에게 주실 것입니다. 여러분은 그들을 쫓아내고 그들의 성읍과 집에서 살게 될 것입니다. 그때가 되면,

pt.L: Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, exterminar as nações cuja terra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te dá, e tu as desapossares e habitares nas cidades delas e nas casas delas,
pt.B: Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, tiver destruído as nações cuja terra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, está te dando, e tu as tiveres expulsado e te tiveres estabelecido nas cidades e nas casas delas,
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, vai destruir as nações cuja terra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está te dando. Tu vais expulsá-las e morar nas cidades e nas casas delas. Quando esse tempo chegar,

am.L: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝቦቹን፣ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምድራቸውን የሚሰጥህን፣ ባጠፋ ጊዜ፣ አንተም ወርሰሃቸው በከተሞቻቸውና በቤቶቻቸው በተቀመጥክ ጊዜ፣
am.B: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምድራቸውን የሚሰጥህን ሕዝቦች አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ካጠፋቸው በኋላ፣ አንተም ካስወጣሃቸውና በከተሞቻቸውና በቤቶቻቸው ከሰፈርክ በኋላ፣
am.R: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምድራቸውን የሚሰጥህን ሕዝቦች ያጠፋል። አንተም ታስወጣቸዋለህ፤ በከተሞቻቸውና በቤቶቻቸውም ትኖራለህ። ያ ጊዜ ሲደርስ፣

hi.L: जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर उन जातियों को नाश कर दें जिनका देश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें दे रहे हैं, और तुम उन्हें बेदख़ल करके उनके नगरों और उनके घरों में बस जाओ,
hi.B: जब {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर उन जातियों को नाश कर चुकें जिनका देश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें दे रहे हैं, और तुम उन्हें निकालकर उनके नगरों और घरों में बस जाओ,
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर उन जातियों को नाश कर देंगे जिनका देश वे तुम्हें दे रहे हैं। तुम उन्हें निकाल दोगे और उनके नगरों और घरों में रहने लगोगे। जब वह समय आए,

ru.L: Когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, истребит народы, землю которых {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе, и ты изгонишь их и поселишься в их городах и в их домах,
ru.B: Когда {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, уничтожит народы, землю которых {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе, и ты прогонишь их и поселишься в их городах и домах,
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, уничтожит народы, землю которых {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} тебе даёт. Ты прогонишь их и будешь жить в их городах и домах. Когда это время придёт,

ja.L: あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたにその地を与えてくださる国々を断ち、あなたが彼らを追い払って、彼らの町々と彼らの家々に住むようになるとき、
ja.B: あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が国々を滅ぼされ、その国々の土地をあなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに与えてくださって、あなたが彼らを追い払い、その町々や家々に住むようになったら、
ja.R: あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分があなたに与えてくださる土地に住む国々を、滅ぼされる。あなたは彼らを追い出して、彼らの町や家に住むようになる。そのときが来たら、

uk.L: Коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, винищить народи, чий край {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі, і ти виженеш їх, і житимеш у їхніх містах і в їхніх домах,
uk.B: Коли {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, знищить народи, чий край {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі, і ти виженеш їх і оселишся в їхніх містах і домах,
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, знищить народи, чий край {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дає тобі. Ти виженеш їх і житимеш у їхніх містах і домах. Коли настане той час,

id.L: Apabila {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, telah melenyapkan bangsa-bangsa yang negerinya diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, kepadamu, dan engkau telah menghalau mereka dan diam di kota-kota mereka dan di rumah-rumah mereka,
id.B: Apabila {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, telah membinasakan bangsa-bangsa yang negerinya diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, kepadamu, dan engkau telah menghalau mereka serta menetap di kota-kota dan rumah-rumah mereka,
id.R: {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, akan membinasakan bangsa-bangsa yang negerinya diberikan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} kepada kalian. Kalian akan mengusir mereka dan tinggal di kota-kota dan rumah-rumah mereka. Apabila waktu itu tiba,

zh.L: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}剪除那些民族，就是{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}要把他们的地赐给你的那些民族，你赶出了他们，住在他们的城里和他们的房屋里的时候，
zh.B: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}要把一些民族的地赐给你。{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}除灭了那些民族，你赶出了他们，住进了他们的城镇和房屋以后，
zh.R: {{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}会消灭那些民族，把他们的土地赐给你。你会赶走他们，住进他们的城镇和房屋。到了那个时候，

tl.L: Kapag nilipol na {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos ang mga bansang ang lupain ay ibinibigay sa iyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos, at napalayas mo na sila at nanirahan ka sa kanilang mga lungsod at sa kanilang mga bahay,
tl.B: Kapag nalipol na {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos ang mga bansang ang lupain ay ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, at napalayas na ninyo sila at nanirahan sa kanilang mga lungsod at mga bahay,
tl.R: Lilipulin {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos ang mga bansang ang lupain ay ibinibigay {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} sa inyo. Palalayasin ninyo sila at maninirahan kayo sa kanilang mga bayan at mga bahay. Pagdating ng panahong iyon,

pa.L: ਜਦ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਢ ਸੁੱਟਣ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਦੇਸ਼ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਘਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸ ਜਾਵੇਂ,
pa.B: ਜਦ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਸ ਕਰ ਦੇਣ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਧਰਤੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਅਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਭਜਾ ਕੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਘਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿਣ ਲੱਗੇਂ,
pa.R: {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੌਮਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਸ ਕਰਨਗੇ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਉਹ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ। ਤੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਘਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹੇਂਗਾ। ਜਦ ਉਹ ਸਮਾਂ ਆਵੇ,

decisions.choice: the law of the cities of refuge, now for the land west of the Jordan
decisions.reason: The LORD commanded six cities of refuge, three on each side of the Jordan (Numbers 35:9-15). Moses has already set apart the three on the east side (4:41-43). This chapter commands the three in the land Israel is about to enter, and adds the rules that decide who may stay in them.

decisions.choice: cuts off: destroys, removes completely
decisions.reason: To "cut off" a nation is to destroy it as a people in its land. The same opening is used for the law on worship in 12:29.

decisions.choice: dispossess them: drive them out and take their place
decisions.reason: The verb means to take possession, and with people as its object, to take over what was theirs by driving them out. Israel will then live in the towns and houses the nations leave behind (6:10-11).

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word covers both cities and smaller walled towns. Balanced and Readable say "towns" for ordinary places where people live, and keep "cities" in the fixed term "cities of refuge" (Readable "towns of safety", as Numbers 35). Literal says "cities" throughout.

decisions.choice: ... will destroy ... When that time comes,
decisions.reason: Readable states the events of the time clause as plain sentences, then picks up the time clause with "When that time comes", so that the command of verse 2 can follow in a short sentence. It says "he" for the second mention of the LORD.

decisions.choice: "tú" for Israel addressed in the singular ("tu Dios", "te"), with the plural_you span only where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 19, "you shall do to him")
decisions.reason: Moses addresses Israel as one person through the chapter, as the Hebrew singular forms show.

decisions.choice: "ciudades" at every level
decisions.reason: The English says "towns" at Balanced and Readable. Spanish keeps "ciudades", the word for the cities of refuge in Numbers 35 and Deuteronomy 4, so that the towns of verse 1 and the cities set apart in verse 2 read as the same kind of place.

decisions.choice: "tu" for Israel addressed in the singular, "vous" where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 19)
decisions.reason: French follows the Hebrew number of "you", as in the rest of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: singular forms ("wako", "utayafukuza") for Israel addressed as one, plural ("mtamtendea") where the Hebrew turns to the plural (verse 19)
decisions.reason: Swahili follows the Hebrew number of "you", as in the rest of Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: tu where Moses speaks to Israel in the singular, vocês where the Hebrew is plural
decisions.reason: For the whole book. Moses speaks to Israel, and the Hebrew moves between the singular "you", which speaks to the nation as one person, and the plural (m4 of verse 19). Literal follows the Hebrew number word by word ("tu", "te", "teu" / "vocês"); Balanced and Readable follow it sentence by sentence, so that no sentence mixes "tu" and "vocês", as Leviticus 19:2 does in Portuguese. Laws are in the future at Literal and Balanced ("separarás") and in the imperative of "tu" at Readable ("separa", "não tenhas pena").

decisions.choice: a terra que o SENHOR, o teu Deus, te dá (L); ... está te dando (B, R)
alternatives: a terra que o SENHOR, o teu Deus, vai te dar
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as 1:20 sets it in Portuguese: the recurring formula keeps one wording per level, "a terra que o SENHOR, o teu Deus, te dá" at Literal and "... está te dando" at Balanced and Readable, both saying that the gift is already under way (the Hebrew participle), with "o teu Deus" set off by commas. What the Hebrew adds is added in the same place: "como herança", "para possuí-la" (L), "para possuíres" (B), "para ser tua" (R).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The English of this chapter capitalises pronouns for God under the deity_pronoun setting. Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the Amharic has nothing for that setting to change and carries no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; honorific "वे", "उन्होंने" for God
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi, and the Hindi text has no deity_pronoun spans. Respect for God comes from the honorific third person at every level. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: Literal repeats "あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}" in the relative clause, as the Hebrew does
alternatives: "その地を与えてくださる" with the name once
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the LORD twice; the English Literal keeps both, so Japanese keeps both spans.

decisions.choice: "ご自分が" with no span for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}
decisions.reason: Japanese has no deity_pronoun spans; a reflexive respect form refers back to the LORD.

decisions.choice: "kota perlindungan" (heading); "penuntut balas darah" (L, B), "kerabat yang membalas kematian itu" (R) for the avenger of blood
decisions.reason: The cities where one who has killed by accident may flee; the go'el haddam is the kinsman who avenges a death, kept apart from "penebus", the kinsman who redeems in Ruth.

decisions.choice: 神 (default), 上帝 (reader setting)
decisions.reason: The word for God is the Chinese reader setting god_term: "神" by default, "上帝" for readers who choose it. The English has no such setting.

decisions.choice: 他 (B)
decisions.reason: Chinese puts the relative clause "whose land the LORD your God is giving you" in a sentence of its own before the main clause, so Balanced refers back to God with a pronoun, in a deity_pronoun span, where the English Balanced repeats no pronoun.

decisions.choice: 城 (L), 城镇 (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English, "城镇" at Balanced and Readable for the towns people live in; "城" for the cities set apart (verses 2-12).

decisions.choice: the verse as a whole
decisions.reason: The law of the cities of refuge, now for the land west of the Jordan (m1); "lungsod na kanlungan" as at Numbers 35.

decisions.choice: "nilipol" (L, B); "Lilipulin ... Pagdating ng panahong iyon" (R)
decisions.reason: Destroys, removes completely (m2), as English (en2).

decisions.choice: "napalayas"; "mga lungsod" (L, B); "mga bayan" (R)
decisions.reason: Drive them out and take their place (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "mo ... ka" (L); "ninyo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal follows the singular of the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable address the assembly as many, as recorded at 1:21 (m1).

source.text: שָׁל֥וֹשׁ עָרִ֖ים תַּבְדִּ֣יל לָ֑ךְ בְּת֣וֹךְ אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: three cities you will set apart for yourself in [the] midst of your land which Yahweh your God [is] giving to you to possess it.

en.L: you shall set apart three cities for yourself in the midst of your land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you to take possession of [it].
en.B: you are to set apart three cities inside your land, the land {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you to take as your own.
en.R: set apart three towns in the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you to own.

es.L: apartarás para ti tres ciudades en medio de tu tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da para que tomes posesión de [ella].
es.B: apartarás tres ciudades dentro de tu tierra, la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da para que la tomes como tuya.
es.R: aparta tres ciudades en la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da para que sea tuya.

fr.L: tu mettras à part pour toi trois villes au milieu de ton pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne pour en prendre possession.
fr.B: tu réserveras trois villes à l’intérieur de ton pays, le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne pour qu’il soit à toi.
fr.R: mets à part trois villes dans le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne pour qu’il t’appartienne.

sw.L: utajitengea miji mitatu katikati ya nchi yako ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa uimiliki.
sw.B: utatenga miji mitatu ndani ya nchi yako, nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa iwe yako.
sw.R: tenga miji mitatu katika nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa iwe mali yako.

vi.L: ngươi phải biệt riêng cho mình ba thành ở giữa xứ của ngươi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đang ban cho ngươi để chiếm hữu [nó].
vi.B: anh em phải biệt riêng ba thành ở giữa xứ của mình, là xứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang ban cho anh em làm của riêng.
vi.R: hãy dành riêng ba thành trong xứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang ban cho anh em làm của mình.

ko.L: 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 너에게 주셔서 차지하게 하시는 네 땅 가운데에 너를 위하여 세 성읍을 구별하여라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서 너희에게 주셔서 차지하게 하시는 땅 안에 세 성읍을 따로 구별하여 두어라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서 여러분의 것으로 주시는 땅에 세 성읍을 따로 정해 두십시오.

pt.L: três cidades separarás para ti no meio da tua terra, que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te dá para possuí-la.
pt.B: separarás três cidades dentro da tua terra, a terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, está te dando para possuíres.
pt.R: separa três cidades na terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, está te dando para ser tua.

am.L: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትወርሳት ዘንድ በሚሰጥህ በምድርህ መካከል ሦስት ከተሞችን ለራስህ ትለያለህ።
am.B: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የራስህ አድርገህ እንድትወርሳት በሚሰጥህ ምድር ውስጥ ሦስት ከተሞችን ለይ።
am.R: አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የራስህ እንድትሆን በሚሰጥህ ምድር ሦስት ከተሞችን ለይ።

hi.L: तो तुम अपने देश के बीच, जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें अधिकार में लेने के लिए दे रहे हैं, अपने लिए तीन नगर अलग करना।
hi.B: तो अपने देश के भीतर, उस देश में जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें अधिकार में लेने के लिए दे रहे हैं, तीन नगर अलग करना।
hi.R: तो जो देश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें दे रहे हैं कि वह तुम्हारा हो, उसमें तीन नगर अलग कर देना।

ru.L: отдели себе три города посреди твоей земли, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе, чтобы овладеть [ею].
ru.B: отдели три города в своей земле, в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе во владение.
ru.R: выдели три города в земле, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе в собственность.

ja.L: あなたは、あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに与えて所有させてくださるあなたの地のただ中に、自分のために三つの町を取り分けなければならない。
ja.B: あなたは、あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに与えて所有させてくださる土地の中に、三つの町を取り分けなさい。
ja.R: あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたのものとして与えてくださる土地の中に、三つの町を取り分けなさい。

uk.L: відокрем собі три міста посеред свого краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі, щоб заволодіти ним.
uk.B: ти маєш відокремити три міста у своєму краю, у краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі у володіння.
uk.R: відокрем три міста в краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі у власність.

id.L: engkau harus memisahkan bagimu tiga kota di tengah-tengah negerimu yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, kepadamu untuk mendudukinya.
id.B: engkau harus memisahkan tiga kota di dalam negerimu, negeri yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, kepadamu untuk menjadi milikmu.
id.R: pisahkanlah tiga kota di negeri yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, kepada kalian menjadi milik kalian.

zh.L: 你要在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你得为业的地中，为自己分别出三座城来。
zh.B: 你要在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你、作为你自己的地中，分别出三座城来。
zh.R: 要在{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你的土地上，分别出三座城来。

tl.L: ay magbubukod ka para sa iyong sarili ng tatlong lungsod sa gitna ng iyong lupaing ibinibigay sa iyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos upang angkinin.
tl.B: ay magbukod kayo ng tatlong lungsod sa loob ng inyong lupain, ang lupaing ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos upang maging inyo.
tl.R: magbukod kayo ng tatlong bayan sa lupaing ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos upang maging inyo.

pa.L: ਤਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ, ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਕਬਜ਼ਾ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਆਪਣੇ ਲਈ ਤਿੰਨ ਨਗਰ ਅਲੱਗ ਕਰੀਂ।
pa.B: ਤਾਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ, ਉਸ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਿਹੜੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਤਿੰਨ ਨਗਰ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਕਰੀਂ।
pa.R: ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ, ਜਿਹੜੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਮਾਲਕ ਬਣਨ ਲਈ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਤਿੰਨ ਨਗਰ ਚੁਣ ਕੇ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਰੱਖੀਂ।

decisions.choice: set apart: separate for a special purpose
decisions.reason: The verb means to divide one thing from others. It is used of Moses setting apart the three eastern cities (4:41) and of the Levites set apart for the LORD's service (10:8).

decisions.choice: in the midst of your land: within the land west of the Jordan
decisions.reason: "Your land" here is the land Israel will take after crossing the river, as verse 1 describes. The three cities east of the Jordan are already set apart (4:41-43).

decisions.choice: for yourself: for the people's own use
decisions.reason: Moses speaks to Israel as one person, "you". The cities are for the whole people, to protect any of them who kills by accident. The word has its pausal form here, at a pause in the verse; the sense is the same as elsewhere.

decisions.choice: to own
decisions.reason: Readable says "to own" for "to possess it", in plain words. Literal and Balanced keep "to possess".

decisions.choice: cidades (every level)
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 35:2 in Portuguese, every level says "cidades" where the English Balanced and Readable say "towns": Portuguese has no plain word between "cidade" and "vila" for a walled town, and "vila" reads as a village or a district. The same in verses 3-12 and in chapters 20-22.

decisions.choice: "magbubukod"
decisions.reason: Separate for a special purpose (m1).

decisions.choice: "sa gitna ng iyong lupain"
decisions.reason: Within the land west of the Jordan (m2).

decisions.choice: "para sa iyong sarili" (L); "upang maging inyo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the people's own use (m3), as English (en1).

source.text: תָּכִ֣ין לְךָ֮ הַדֶּרֶךְ֒ וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־גְּב֣וּל אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַנְחִֽילְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָ֕ה לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה כָּל־רֹצֵֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: You will prepare for yourself the road, and you will divide into three [the] territory of your land which will give you as inheritance Yahweh your God, and it will be for fleeing there [for] every killer.

en.L: You shall prepare the road for yourself, and divide into three [parts] the territory of your land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God gives you as an inheritance; and it shall be for every killer to flee there.
en.B: Prepare the roads, and divide into three regions the territory {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you as your inheritance. Then anyone who has killed someone can flee to one of these cities.
en.R: Make the roads to these towns ready. Divide the land that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God is giving you into three parts, with one town in each part. Then anyone who has killed a person can run away to one of them.

es.L: Prepararás para ti el camino, y dividirás en tres [partes] el territorio de tu tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da en herencia; y será para que huya allí todo homicida.
es.B: Prepara los caminos, y divide en tres regiones el territorio que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da como herencia. Así, cualquiera que haya matado a alguien podrá huir a una de esas ciudades.
es.R: Prepara los caminos que llevan a esas ciudades. Divide en tres partes la tierra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te da, con una ciudad en cada parte. Así, quien haya matado a alguien podrá huir a una de ellas.

fr.L: Tu prépareras pour toi la route, et tu diviseras en trois [parties] le territoire de ton pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne en héritage ; et ce sera pour que tout meurtrier puisse s’y enfuir.
fr.B: Prépare les routes, et divise en trois régions le territoire que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne en héritage. Ainsi, quiconque a tué quelqu’un pourra s’enfuir dans l’une de ces villes.
fr.R: Prépare les routes qui mènent à ces villes. Divise en trois parties le pays que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu te donne, avec une ville dans chaque partie. Ainsi, celui qui a tué quelqu’un pourra s’enfuir dans l’une d’elles.

sw.L: Utajitengenezea njia, na kuligawa katika [sehemu] tatu eneo la nchi yako ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa kuwa urithi; nayo itakuwa ili kila mwuaji akimbilie huko.
sw.B: Tengeneza njia, na uligawe katika maeneo matatu eneo ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa kuwa urithi wako. Hivyo mtu yeyote aliyeua mtu ataweza kukimbilia mmojawapo wa miji hiyo.
sw.R: Tengeneza njia za kwenda kwenye miji hiyo. Igawe nchi ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anakupa katika sehemu tatu, kila sehemu ikiwa na mji mmoja. Hivyo mtu aliyeua mtu ataweza kukimbilia mmojawapo wa miji hiyo.

vi.L: Ngươi phải sửa soạn đường sá cho mình, và chia làm ba [phần] lãnh thổ của xứ ngươi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi ban cho ngươi làm sản nghiệp; và đó sẽ là [nơi] để mọi kẻ giết người trốn đến.
vi.B: Hãy sửa sang đường sá, và chia lãnh thổ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang ban cho anh em làm sản nghiệp ra làm ba vùng. Như vậy, bất cứ ai đã giết người đều có thể trốn đến một trong các thành ấy.
vi.R: Hãy sửa sang đường đi đến các thành ấy. Hãy chia xứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đang ban cho anh em ra làm ba phần, mỗi phần có một thành. Như vậy, ai đã làm chết người đều có thể chạy trốn đến một trong các thành ấy.

ko.L: 너는 너를 위하여 길을 닦고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 너에게 유산으로 주시는 네 땅의 영토를 셋으로 나누어라. 그리하여 살인자는 누구든지 그곳으로 도망할 수 있게 하여라.
ko.B: 그 성읍들로 가는 길을 닦고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서 너희에게 유산으로 주시는 땅을 세 지역으로 나누어라. 그러면 사람을 죽인 사람은 누구든지 그 성읍들 가운데 한 곳으로 도망할 수 있을 것이다.
ko.R: 그 성읍들로 가는 길을 잘 닦아 두십시오. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서 주시는 땅을 세 지역으로 나누어 지역마다 성읍 하나씩을 두십시오. 그러면 사람을 죽인 사람은 누구든지 그 가운데 한 곳으로 도망할 수 있습니다.

pt.L: Prepararás para ti o caminho e dividirás em três [partes] o território da tua terra, que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te dá como herança; e [isso] será para que todo homicida fuja para lá.
pt.B: Prepararás os caminhos e dividirás em três regiões o território que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, está te dando como herança. Assim, quem tiver matado alguém poderá fugir para uma dessas cidades.
pt.R: Deixa prontos os caminhos até essas cidades. Divide em três partes a terra que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, está te dando como herança, com uma cidade em cada parte. Assim, quem matou uma pessoa pode fugir para uma delas.

am.L: መንገዱን ለራስህ ታዘጋጃለህ፤ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ርስት አድርጎ የሚሰጥህን የምድርህን ግዛት በሦስት [ክፍል] ትከፍላለህ፤ ገዳይም ሁሉ ወደዚያ እንዲሸሽ ይሆናል።
am.B: መንገዶቹን አዘጋጅ፤ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ርስት አድርጎ የሚሰጥህን ግዛት በሦስት አውራጃዎች ከፋፍል። ከዚያም ሰው የገደለ ማንም ወደ ከተሞቹ ወደ አንዱ ሊሸሽ ይችላል።
am.R: ወደ እነዚህ ከተሞች የሚወስዱትን መንገዶች አዘጋጅ። አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚሰጥህን ምድር በሦስት ክፍል ከፋፍል፤ በእያንዳንዱም ክፍል አንድ ከተማ ይኑር። ከዚያም ሰው የገደለ ማንም ወደ አንዱ ሸሽቶ ሊሄድ ይችላል።

hi.L: तुम अपने लिए मार्ग तैयार करना, और अपने देश के उस क्षेत्र को जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें निज भाग में देंगे, तीन [भागों] में बाँटना; और वह इसलिए हो कि हर मारनेवाला वहाँ भाग सके।
hi.B: मार्ग तैयार करना, और जो देश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें निज भाग के रूप में दे रहे हैं, उसे तीन क्षेत्रों में बाँटना। तब जिस किसी ने किसी की जान ली हो, वह इनमें से किसी नगर में भाग सकेगा।
hi.R: इन नगरों तक जानेवाले मार्ग तैयार करना। जो देश {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें दे रहे हैं, उसे तीन भागों में बाँटना, और हर भाग में एक नगर हो। तब जिस किसी ने किसी व्यक्ति की जान ली हो, वह भागकर उनमें से किसी एक में जा सकेगा।

ru.L: Приготовь себе дорогу и раздели на три [части] пределы твоей земли, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе в надел; и будет это для того, чтобы туда убегал всякий убийца.
ru.B: Приготовь дороги и раздели на три области землю, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе в удел. Тогда всякий, кто убил человека, сможет убежать в один из этих городов.
ru.R: Приведи в порядок дороги к этим городам. Раздели землю, которую {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, твой Бог, даёт тебе, на три части, с одним городом в каждой. Тогда всякий, кто убил человека, сможет убежать в один из них.

ja.L: あなたは自分のために道を整え、あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに嗣業として受け継がせてくださるあなたの地の領域を三つに分けなければならない。それは、人を殺した者がみな、そこに逃げるためである。
ja.B: 道を整え、あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}があなたに嗣業として与えてくださる土地の領域を三つの地域に分けなさい。そうすれば、人を殺した者はだれでも、それらの町の一つに逃げることができる。
ja.R: それらの町へ行く道を整えなさい。あなたの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が与えてくださる土地を三つに分けて、それぞれに町を一つずつ置きなさい。そうすれば、人を殺してしまった人はだれでも、そのどれかの町へ逃げることができる。

uk.L: Приготуй собі дорогу і поділи на три частини межі свого краю, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дасть тобі в спадщину; і це буде для того, щоб утікав туди кожен убивця.
uk.B: Приготуй дороги й поділи на три округи землю, яку {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі в спадщину. Тоді кожен, хто вбив людину, зможе втекти до одного з цих міст.
uk.R: Приготуй дороги до цих міст. Поділи край, який {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, твій Бог, дає тобі, на три частини, з одним містом у кожній. Тоді кожен, хто вбив людину, зможе втекти до одного з них.

id.L: Engkau harus menyiapkan jalan bagimu dan membagi tiga daerah negerimu yang diwariskan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, kepadamu, supaya setiap pembunuh dapat melarikan diri ke sana.
id.B: Siapkanlah jalan-jalannya, dan bagilah menjadi tiga bagian daerah yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allahmu, kepadamu menjadi milik pusaka. Dengan begitu setiap orang yang telah membunuh seseorang dapat melarikan diri ke salah satu kota itu.
id.R: Siapkanlah jalan-jalan ke kota-kota itu. Bagilah negeri yang diberikan {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kalian, kepada kalian menjadi tiga bagian, dengan satu kota di setiap bagian. Dengan begitu siapa pun yang sudah membunuh orang dapat melarikan diri ke salah satu kota itu.

zh.L: 你要为自己预备道路，把{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你作产业之地的境界分为三[区]，好让每一个杀人的都可以逃到那里。
zh.B: 要修好道路，把{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你作产业的地分成三个地区。这样，任何杀了人的人都可以逃到其中一座城去。
zh.R: 要把通往这些城的道路修好。把{{divine_name:上主|雅威}}你的{{god_term:神|上帝}}赐给你的土地分成三个部分，每一部分有一座城。这样，任何杀了人的人都可以逃到其中一座城去。

tl.L: Ihahanda mo ang daan para sa iyong sarili, at hahatiin mo sa tatlo ang nasasakupan ng iyong lupaing ipinamamana sa iyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} iyong Diyos; at ito ay para sa bawat nakapatay upang tumakas doon.
tl.B: Ihanda ninyo ang mga daan, at hatiin ninyo sa tatlong rehiyon ang nasasakupang ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos bilang inyong mana. Sa gayon ay maaaring tumakas sa isa sa mga lungsod na ito ang sinumang nakapatay ng tao.
tl.R: Ihanda ninyo ang mga daan patungo sa mga bayang ito. Hatiin ninyo sa tatlong bahagi ang lupaing ibinibigay sa inyo {{divine_name:ng PANGINOONG|ni Yahweh na}} inyong Diyos, na may isang bayan sa bawat bahagi. Sa gayon ay maaaring tumakas sa isa sa mga iyon ang sinumang nakapatay ng tao.

pa.L: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਲਈ ਰਾਹ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੀਂ, ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਦੇਸ਼ ਦੀਆਂ ਹੱਦਾਂ ਨੂੰ, ਜਿਹੜਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤਿੰਨ [ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ] ਵਿੱਚ ਵੰਡੀਂ; ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਇਸ ਲਈ ਹੋਵੇ ਕਿ ਹਰ ਖ਼ੂਨੀ ਉੱਥੇ ਭੱਜ ਜਾਵੇ।
pa.B: ਸੜਕਾਂ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੀਂ, ਅਤੇ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਇਲਾਕਾ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਤਿੰਨ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੰਡੀਂ। ਤਦ ਜਿਸ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੀ ਜਾਨ ਲਈ ਹੋਵੇ ਉਹ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੱਜ ਸਕੇਗਾ।
pa.R: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਰਾਹ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੀਂ। ਜਿਹੜੀ ਧਰਤੀ {{divine_name:ਪ੍ਰਭੂ|ਯਾਹਵੇ}} ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਮੇਸ਼ੁਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਤਿੰਨ ਹਿੱਸਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੰਡੀਂ, ਹਰ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਨਗਰ। ਤਦ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰ ਬੈਠੇ, ਉਹ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੱਜ ਕੇ ਜਾ ਸਕੇਗਾ।

decisions.choice: prepare the road: make the way to the cities ready and easy to travel
alternatives: measure the distances to the cities
decisions.reason: The verb means to make ready or to set firmly in place. With "the road" it most likely means to keep the roads to the cities open and in good order, so that a killer can reach one quickly (verse 6). Some read it as "measure the way", that is, work out the distances so that the three cities are evenly placed, which would fit the dividing of the land in the next clause.

decisions.choice: divide into three: three districts, one city in each
decisions.reason: The verb is formed from the number three. The land is to be divided into three regions, each with its own city, so that no part of it is too far from a refuge (verse 6). Joshua 20:7 names one city in the north, one in the middle and one in the south.

decisions.choice: every killer: anyone who has taken a human life
decisions.reason: The word names anyone who has killed a person, whether by accident or on purpose (Numbers 35:6). Anyone may flee to the city; verses 4-13 then decide who may stay there and who must be handed over.

decisions.choice: anyone who has killed someone
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "killer" for this word every time, as in Numbers 35. Balanced and Readable say "anyone who has killed someone" where the killing may have been an accident, and "murderer" where the law speaks of a deliberate killing (verses 11-12).

decisions.choice: the roads / to these towns; with one town in each part
decisions.reason: Balanced says "roads", since the road to each city is meant. Readable adds "to these towns" and "with one town in each part", which the purpose of the dividing implies (verses 2 and 6).

decisions.choice: "le meurtrier" (L), "celui qui a tué quelqu'un" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one word for the Hebrew "killer", as in Deuteronomy 4:42 and Numbers 35, taken in its older sense of anyone who has caused a death. Balanced and Readable say "celui qui a tué quelqu'un" where the killing may be an accident, and keep "meurtrier" for deliberate killing (verse 12).

decisions.choice: "살인자" (Literal), "사람을 죽인 사람" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As Joshua 20 in this translation: the Hebrew word covers any killer, so the Balanced and Readable avoid "살인자", which suggests murder. Recorded once for Deuteronomy 16-25.

decisions.choice: o homicida (L); quem matou alguém (B, R); o assassino (B, R) for a deliberate killer
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as Numbers 35:6 has it in Portuguese. Literal says "o homicida" each time this word comes, since it names anyone who has killed a person, with or without intent (m3). Balanced and Readable say "quem matou alguém" where the killing may have been an accident, and "o assassino" where the law speaks of murder (verses 11-13).

decisions.choice: "killer" (rotseach) as "ገዳይ" (L); "ሰው የገደለ" (B, R); "ነፍሰ ገዳይ" where the English says "murderer" (verse 12)
decisions.reason: As in the Amharic of Numbers 35, the law of these cities: Literal keeps one word for every killer, and Balanced and Readable tell the one who has killed by accident from the murderer, as the English levels do. Likewise "without knowing" is "ሳያውቅ" (L), "በስሕተት" (B) and "ሳያስበው" (R) in verse 4.

decisions.choice: rotseach "人を殺した者" (L, B), "人を殺してしまった人" (R), used for this word through ch. 19
decisions.reason: The word covers a killing without intent here; "殺人者" would sound like a murderer.

decisions.choice: "убивця" (L), "той, хто вбив людину" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names anyone who has taken a life, by accident or not; Balanced and Readable describe it so as not to imply murder.

decisions.choice: 杀人的 (L), 杀了人的人 (B, R)
decisions.reason: The rotseaḥ (m3) is anyone who has taken a life, deliberately or not: "杀人的" at Literal every time; Balanced and Readable "杀了人的人", keeping "凶手" for the murderer of verse 12, as the English keeps "murderer" there.

decisions.choice: "Ihahanda mo ang daan"; "mga daan patungo sa mga bayang ito" (R)
decisions.reason: Make the way to the cities ready and easy to travel (m1), as English (en2).

decisions.choice: "hahatiin mo sa tatlo"; "isang bayan sa bawat bahagi" (R)
decisions.reason: Three districts, one city in each (m2), as English (en2).

decisions.choice: "bawat nakapatay" (L); "sinumang nakapatay ng tao" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Anyone who has taken a human life (m3), as English (en1).

source.text: וְזֶה֙ דְּבַ֣ר הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־יָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה וָחָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַכֶּ֤ה אֶת־רֵעֵ֨הוּ֙ בִּבְלִי־דַ֔עַת וְה֛וּא לֹא־שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖וֹ מִתְּמֹ֥ל שִׁלְשֹֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And this [is the] case of the killer who will flee there and live: who strikes his neighbor without knowledge, and he not [was] hating him from yesterday [and the] third day.

en.L: And this [is] the case of the killer who may flee there and live: whoever strikes his neighbor without knowing, and he was not hating him in time past.
en.B: This is the rule for the killer who may flee there and stay alive: it is anyone who kills a neighbor by accident, without having hated that neighbor before.
en.R: Here is who may run to one of these towns and stay alive. It is someone who killed another person by accident, and who had not hated that person before.

es.L: Y este [es] el caso del homicida que podrá huir allí y vivir: el que hiera a su prójimo sin saber[lo], no habiéndolo odiado en tiempo pasado.
es.B: Esta es la norma para quien haya matado a alguien y pueda huir allí y salvar la vida: es cualquiera que mate a su prójimo por accidente, sin haberlo odiado antes.
es.R: Esta es la persona que puede huir a una de esas ciudades y salvar su vida. Es quien mató a otra persona por accidente y no la odiaba antes.

fr.L: Et voici le cas du meurtrier qui pourra s’enfuir là et vivre : celui qui aura frappé son prochain sans le savoir, et qui ne le haïssait pas auparavant.
fr.B: Voici la règle pour celui qui a tué et qui peut s’enfuir là pour rester en vie : il s’agit de quiconque a tué son prochain par accident, sans l’avoir haï auparavant.
fr.R: Voici qui peut s’enfuir dans l’une de ces villes et rester en vie. C’est celui qui a tué une autre personne par accident, et qui ne la détestait pas avant.

sw.L: Na hii [ndiyo] habari ya mwuaji atakayekimbilia huko na kuishi: yeyote ampigaye jirani yake bila kujua, wala hakuwa akimchukia tangu zamani.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo hali ya mtu aliyeua ambaye anaweza kukimbilia huko na kubaki hai: ni mtu yeyote anayemwua jirani yake kwa bahati mbaya, bila kuwa amemchukia hapo kabla.
sw.R: Huyu ndiye mtu anayeweza kukimbilia mmojawapo wa miji hii na kubaki hai. Ni mtu aliyemwua mwenzake kwa bahati mbaya, na ambaye hakuwa amemchukia hapo kabla.

vi.L: Và đây [là] trường hợp của kẻ giết người có thể trốn đến đó và được sống: ai đánh người lân cận mình mà không biết, và trước đây người ấy không ghét người kia.
vi.B: Đây là luật áp dụng cho kẻ giết người được trốn đến đó để giữ mạng sống: đó là người vô ý giết người lân cận mình, mà trước đó không hề thù ghét người ấy.
vi.R: Đây là người được chạy trốn đến một trong các thành ấy để giữ mạng sống: người đã vô ý làm chết người khác, và trước đó không hề ghét người ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그곳으로 도망하여 살 수 있는 살인자의 경우는 이러하다. 알지 못하고 자기 이웃을 쳤고, 전에 그를 미워하지 않았던 사람이다.
ko.B: 그곳으로 도망하여 목숨을 건질 수 있는 사람은 이러하다. 전부터 미워한 일도 없는 이웃을 실수로 죽인 사람이다.
ko.R: 이 성읍들로 도망하여 목숨을 건질 수 있는 사람은 이런 사람입니다. 실수로 다른 사람을 죽였고, 전에 그 사람을 미워한 적이 없는 사람입니다.

pt.L: E este [é] o caso do homicida que fugir para lá e viver: aquele que ferir o seu próximo sem saber, e ele não o odiava no passado.
pt.B: Esta é a regra para quem matou alguém e pode fugir para lá e salvar a vida: é quem matar o seu próximo sem intenção, sem ter tido ódio dele antes.
pt.R: Esta é a pessoa que pode fugir para uma dessas cidades e continuar viva: alguém que matou outra pessoa por acidente e que não odiava essa pessoa antes.

am.L: ወደዚያም ሸሽቶ በሕይወት የሚኖረው የገዳዩ ጉዳይ ይህ ነው፤ ባልንጀራውን ሳያውቅ የመታ፣ ከትናንትና ከትናንት ወዲያም ያልጠላው፤
am.B: ሰው የገደለ ሰው ወደዚያ ሸሽቶ በሕይወት ሊኖር የሚችለው በዚህ ደንብ ነው፤ ቀድሞ ሳይጠላው ባልንጀራውን በስሕተት የገደለ ከሆነ ነው።
am.R: ወደ እነዚህ ከተሞች ሸሽቶ በሕይወት ሊኖር የሚችለው ይህ ሰው ነው፦ ሳያስበው ሌላውን ሰው የገደለና ቀደም ብሎ ያንን ሰው ያልጠላ ሰው።

hi.L: और जो मारनेवाला वहाँ भागकर जीवित रहे, उसका मामला यह [है]: जो अपने पड़ोसी को अनजाने में मारे, और वह पहले से उससे बैर न रखता था।
hi.B: जो मारनेवाला वहाँ भागकर जीवित रह सकता है, उसके लिए नियम यह है: वह व्यक्ति जिसने अपने पड़ोसी को अनजाने में मार डाला हो, और पहले से उससे बैर न रखता हो।
hi.R: इन नगरों में कौन भागकर जीवित रह सकता है, यह इस प्रकार है। वह व्यक्ति जिसने किसी को अनजाने में मार डाला हो, और जो पहले से उससे बैर न रखता हो।

ru.L: И вот случай убийцы, который может убежать туда и остаться жить: кто убьёт своего ближнего без умысла, а он не ненавидел его ни вчера, ни третьего дня.
ru.B: Вот правило для убийцы, который может убежать туда и остаться в живых: это тот, кто убил ближнего нечаянно, не питая к нему ненависти прежде.
ru.R: Вот кто может убежать в один из этих городов и остаться в живых. Это тот, кто убил другого человека случайно и раньше не испытывал к нему ненависти.

ja.L: そして、そこに逃げて生きることのできる、人を殺した者の場合はこうである。知らずに自分の隣人を打ち、昨日もおとといも彼を憎んでいなかった者である。
ja.B: そこに逃げて生き延びることができる、人を殺した者についての定めはこうである。それは、以前から憎んでいたわけではない隣人を、誤って殺してしまった者である。
ja.R: これらの町の一つに逃げて、生き延びることができるのは、こういう人である。それは、うっかりほかの人を殺してしまったが、その人をそれまで憎んではいなかった人である。

uk.L: І ось справа вбивці, який утече туди й житиме: хто вдарить свого ближнього ненароком, і він не ненавидів його ні вчора, ні позавчора.
uk.B: Ось правило для вбивці, який може втекти туди й залишитися живим: це той, хто вбив свого ближнього ненавмисно, не маючи до нього ненависті раніше.
uk.R: Ось хто може втекти до одного з цих міст і залишитися живим. Це той, хто вбив іншу людину випадково й раніше не ненавидів її.

id.L: Dan inilah perkara pembunuh yang boleh melarikan diri ke sana dan hidup: orang yang membunuh sesamanya tanpa sengaja, dan ia tidak membencinya sejak kemarin dan kemarin dulu.
id.B: Inilah aturan bagi pembunuh yang boleh melarikan diri ke sana dan tetap hidup: siapa saja yang membunuh sesamanya tanpa sengaja, tanpa membencinya sebelumnya.
id.R: Inilah orang yang boleh melarikan diri ke salah satu kota itu dan tetap hidup. Orang itu sudah membunuh orang lain tanpa sengaja, dan sebelumnya ia tidak membenci orang itu.

zh.L: 杀人的逃到那里可以存活，[他的]案例是这样：凡不知不觉打死了他的邻舍，而他从前与他并无仇恨的，
zh.B: 杀了人的人可以逃到那里保住性命，这条规定是这样的：凡是无意中杀了邻舍，以前和那邻舍并没有仇恨的人，
zh.R: 什么样的人可以逃到这些城里保住性命呢？就是不小心杀了别人，而且以前并不恨那个人的人。

tl.L: At ito ang usapin ng nakapatay na maaaring tumakas doon at mabuhay: ang sinumang nakapatay sa kaniyang kapwa nang hindi sinasadya, at hindi niya ito kinapopootan noong nakaraan.
tl.B: Ito ang tuntunin para sa nakapatay na maaaring tumakas doon at manatiling buháy: siya ang sinumang nakapatay sa kaniyang kapwa nang hindi sinasadya, nang hindi kinapootan ang kapwang iyon noon.
tl.R: Ito ang maaaring tumakas sa isa sa mga bayang ito at manatiling buháy. Siya ang taong nakapatay ng kapwa nang hindi sinasadya, at hindi niya kinapootan ang taong iyon noon.

pa.L: ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਖ਼ੂਨੀ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਇਹ [ਹੈ] ਜਿਹੜਾ ਉੱਥੇ ਭੱਜ ਕੇ ਜੀਉਂਦਾ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ: ਜਿਹੜਾ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਨੂੰ ਅਣਜਾਣੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਾਰ ਦੇਵੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਵੈਰ ਨਾ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਸੀ।
pa.B: ਜਿਹੜਾ ਖ਼ੂਨੀ ਉੱਥੇ ਭੱਜ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਾਨ ਬਚਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਲਈ ਨਿਯਮ ਇਹ ਹੈ: ਉਹ ਅਜਿਹਾ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਇਰਾਦੇ ਦੇ ਮਾਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਅਤੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਕੋਈ ਵੈਰ ਨਾ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੇ।
pa.R: ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੱਜ ਕੇ ਜਾਨ ਬਚਾਉਣ ਦਾ ਹੱਕ ਇਸ ਬੰਦੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ: ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਅਚਾਨਕ ਮਾਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਨਫ਼ਰਤ ਨਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੋਵੇ।

decisions.choice: the case: the rule that applies
decisions.reason: The word means a word or a matter. Here it introduces the kind of killer the law protects, as in 15:2 it introduces the rule for the release of debts.

decisions.choice: strikes ... without knowledge: kills without meaning to
decisions.reason: To strike someone here is to deal a blow that kills. "Without knowledge" means without intending it, by accident, as in 4:42. Verse 5 gives an example.

decisions.choice: from yesterday and the third day: before, in time past
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "yesterday and the day before" for any time before. The killer had no hatred for the one who died, which shows that it was not murder (4:42; verse 11).

decisions.choice: his neighbor: a fellow member of the community
decisions.reason: The word means a companion or fellow, anyone a person lives and works with, not only someone living next door. The law is written with masculine words but covers any killer and any victim (4:42).

decisions.choice: anyone who kills a neighbor ... that neighbor / another person
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use words that are already inclusive, as in 4:42. Literal keeps the masculine words of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "trước đây" (L) for "from yesterday and the third day"
decisions.reason: The idiom means "before, in time past" (meaning decision); Vietnamese "hôm qua hôm kia" would sound like two particular days, so even Literal gives the sense.

decisions.choice: "전에"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew idiom "from yesterday, the third day" means "before"; even the Literal says "전에", as the English Literal says "in time past".

decisions.choice: o seu próximo (L, B), outra pessoa (R); sem saber (L), sem intenção (B), por acidente (R)
decisions.reason: "Próximo" is the Portuguese word for the neighbor of the law, any fellow member of the community (m4), as Leviticus 19:13 has it; it is generic, like "alguém", so it covers any victim. Readable says "outra pessoa", as the English Readable does. For "without knowledge" (m2), Balanced says "sem intenção" and Readable "por acidente", as Numbers 35:11.

decisions.choice: "from yesterday and the third day" as "ከትናንትና ከትናንት ወዲያ"
decisions.reason: Amharic has the same idiom for "before, in time past" (yesterday and the day before), so Literal keeps the Hebrew picture without brackets; Balanced and Readable say "ቀድሞ", "ቀደም ብሎ" (before). Also in verse 6.

decisions.choice: "पहले से" for "from yesterday and the third day"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew idiom means before, in time past (m3). Hindi "कल-परसों" would sound like the last two days only, so every level says "पहले से".

decisions.choice: "ни вчера, ни третьего дня"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom for time past (m3), which Russian also has; Balanced and Readable say "прежде", "раньше".

decisions.choice: "昨日もおとといも" for "from yesterday and the third day"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom; Japanese "昨日もおとといも" reads naturally as "before now".

decisions.choice: "ні вчора, ні позавчора"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "yesterday and the third day", which Ukrainian can say almost word for word; the other levels say "раніше".

decisions.choice: 从前
decisions.reason: "From yesterday and the third day" (m3) means in time past: "从前" at Literal too, since the Hebrew pair read word for word would be taken as two actual days.

decisions.choice: "usapin" (L); "tuntunin" (B)
decisions.reason: The rule that applies (m1).

decisions.choice: "nang hindi sinasadya"
decisions.reason: Kills without meaning to (m2); wording as at Numbers 35:11.

decisions.choice: "noong nakaraan" (L); "noon" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Before, in time past (m3).

decisions.choice: "kapwa"
decisions.reason: A fellow member of the community (m4), as English (en1).
The Hebrew idiom "yesterday and the day before" means previously.

source.text: וַאֲשֶׁר֩ יָבֹ֨א אֶת־רֵעֵ֥הוּ בַיַּעַר֮ לַחְטֹ֣ב עֵצִים֒ וְנִדְּחָ֨ה יָד֤וֹ בַגַּרְזֶן֙ לִכְרֹ֣ת הָעֵ֔ץ וְנָשַׁ֤ל הַבַּרְזֶל֙ מִן־הָעֵ֔ץ וּמָצָ֥א אֶת־רֵעֵ֖הוּ וָמֵ֑ת ה֗וּא יָנ֛וּס אֶל־אַחַ֥ת הֶעָרִים־הָאֵ֖לֶּה וָחָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And who goes with his neighbor into the forest to cut wood, and is driven his hand with the axe to cut down the tree, and slips the iron from the wood and finds his neighbor and he dies, he will flee to one of the cities these and live;

en.L: As when one goes into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and his hand swings with the ax to cut down the tree, and the iron slips off the wood and finds his neighbor, and he dies: he shall flee to one of these cities and live,
en.B: For example, someone goes into the forest with a neighbor to cut wood. As the ax is swung to fell a tree, the head flies off the handle and strikes the neighbor, who dies. The one who was cutting may flee to one of these cities and stay alive,
en.R: Suppose two neighbors go into the woods to cut wood. One of them swings an ax to chop down a tree, but the ax head comes off the handle. It hits the other one, who dies. The one who swung the ax can run away to one of these towns and stay alive.

es.L: Como cuando alguien entra en el bosque con su prójimo a cortar leña, y su mano empuja el hacha para cortar el árbol, y el hierro se suelta de la madera y alcanza a su prójimo, y este muere: él huirá a una de estas ciudades y vivirá,
es.B: Por ejemplo, alguien va al bosque con su prójimo a cortar leña. Al blandir el hacha para derribar un árbol, la cabeza se sale del mango y golpea al compañero, que muere. El que estaba cortando podrá huir a una de estas ciudades y salvar la vida,
es.R: Supongamos que dos vecinos van al bosque a cortar leña. Uno de ellos da un golpe con el hacha para tumbar un árbol, pero la cabeza del hacha se sale del mango. Golpea al otro, y este muere. El que movió el hacha puede huir a una de estas ciudades y salvar su vida.

fr.L: Ainsi, quand quelqu’un va dans la forêt avec son prochain pour couper du bois, que sa main s’élance avec la hache pour abattre l’arbre, que le fer se détache du bois et atteigne son prochain, et qu’il meure : celui-là s’enfuira dans l’une de ces villes et vivra,
fr.B: Par exemple, quelqu’un va dans la forêt avec son prochain pour couper du bois. Au moment où il lève la hache pour abattre un arbre, le fer se détache du manche et frappe son compagnon, qui meurt. Celui qui coupait le bois pourra s’enfuir dans l’une de ces villes et rester en vie,
fr.R: Imaginons que deux voisins aillent couper du bois dans la forêt. L’un d’eux donne un coup de hache pour abattre un arbre, mais le fer se détache du manche. Il frappe l’autre, qui meurt. Celui qui tenait la hache peut s’enfuir dans l’une de ces villes et rester en vie.

sw.L: Kama mtu aendapo msituni pamoja na jirani yake kukata kuni, na mkono wake ukapiga kwa shoka ili kuukata mti, na chuma kikachomoka kutoka kwenye mti, kikampata jirani yake, naye akafa: yeye atakimbilia mmojawapo wa miji hii na kuishi,
sw.B: Kwa mfano, mtu anakwenda msituni pamoja na jirani yake kukata kuni. Anapopiga shoka ili kuangusha mti, kichwa cha shoka kinachomoka kwenye mpini na kumpiga jirani yake, naye akafa. Yule aliyekuwa akikata anaweza kukimbilia mmojawapo wa miji hii na kubaki hai,
sw.R: Tuseme majirani wawili wanakwenda porini kukata kuni. Mmoja wao anapiga shoka ili kuangusha mti, lakini kichwa cha shoka kinachomoka kwenye mpini. Kinampiga yule mwingine, naye anakufa. Yule aliyepiga shoka anaweza kukimbilia mmojawapo wa miji hii na kubaki hai.

vi.L: Như khi một người đi vào rừng với người lân cận mình để đốn gỗ, và tay người ấy vung rìu để chặt cây, và lưỡi sắt tuột khỏi cán gỗ và trúng người lân cận, và người kia chết: người ấy sẽ trốn đến một trong các thành này và được sống,
vi.B: Chẳng hạn, một người cùng người lân cận vào rừng đốn gỗ. Khi người ấy vung rìu chặt cây, lưỡi rìu văng khỏi cán và trúng người lân cận khiến người kia chết. Người đốn cây ấy có thể trốn đến một trong các thành này để giữ mạng sống,
vi.R: Giả sử hai người láng giềng vào rừng đốn gỗ. Một người vung rìu chặt cây, nhưng lưỡi rìu văng ra khỏi cán. Nó trúng người kia và người ấy chết. Người đã vung rìu có thể chạy trốn đến một trong các thành này để giữ mạng sống.

ko.L: 예를 들어, 어떤 사람이 나무를 하려고 자기 이웃과 함께 숲에 들어가서, 나무를 베려고 손으로 도끼를 휘둘렀는데, 쇠가 나무[자루]에서 빠져 그의 이웃을 맞혀 그가 죽었다면, 그 사람은 이 성읍들 가운데 한 곳으로 도망하여 살 것이다.
ko.B: 예를 들어, 어떤 사람이 이웃과 함께 나무를 하러 숲에 들어갔다고 하자. 나무를 베려고 도끼를 휘둘렀는데, 도끼날이 자루에서 빠져 이웃을 맞혀서 그 이웃이 죽었다. 그러면 나무를 베던 그 사람은 이 성읍들 가운데 한 곳으로 도망하여 목숨을 건질 수 있다.
ko.R: 이웃 두 사람이 나무를 하러 숲에 들어갔다고 합시다. 한 사람이 나무를 베려고 도끼를 휘둘렀는데, 도끼날이 자루에서 빠져 버렸습니다. 그 도끼날이 다른 사람을 맞혀서 그 사람이 죽었습니다. 그러면 도끼를 휘두른 사람은 이 성읍들 가운데 한 곳으로 도망하여 목숨을 건질 수 있습니다.

pt.L: E quem for com o seu próximo à mata para cortar lenha, e a sua mão for impelida com o machado para cortar a árvore, e o ferro escapar da madeira e alcançar o seu próximo, e ele morrer: ele fugirá para uma destas cidades e viverá,
pt.B: Por exemplo: alguém vai com o seu próximo à mata para cortar lenha. Quando o machado desce com força para derrubar uma árvore, o ferro se solta do cabo e atinge o outro, que morre. Quem estava cortando poderá fugir para uma destas cidades e salvar a vida,
pt.R: Imagina que duas pessoas vão juntas à mata para cortar lenha. Uma delas levanta o machado para derrubar uma árvore, mas o ferro do machado se solta do cabo. O ferro atinge a outra pessoa, e ela morre. Quem usou o machado pode fugir para uma destas cidades e continuar vivo.

am.L: ከባልንጀራው ጋር እንጨት ለመቁረጥ ወደ ዱር እንደሚሄድ፣ ዛፉንም ለመቁረጥ እጁ በመጥረቢያው ሲሰነዝር፣ ብረቱም ከእንጨቱ ወልቆ ባልንጀራውን ቢያገኘውና ቢሞት፣ እርሱ ከእነዚህ ከተሞች ወደ አንዱ ሸሽቶ በሕይወት ይኖራል፤
am.B: ለምሳሌ አንድ ሰው እንጨት ለመቁረጥ ከባልንጀራው ጋር ወደ ዱር ይሄዳል። ዛፍ ለመጣል መጥረቢያውን ሲሰነዝር ብረቱ ከእጀታው ወልቆ ባልንጀራውን ይመታዋል፤ ባልንጀራውም ይሞታል። ይህ ሰው ከእነዚህ ከተሞች ወደ አንዱ ሸሽቶ በሕይወት ሊኖር ይችላል፤
am.R: ሁለት ባልንጀሮች እንጨት ለመቁረጥ ወደ ጫካ ይሄዳሉ እንበል። አንዱ ዛፍ ለመቁረጥ መጥረቢያ ሲሰነዝር የመጥረቢያው ብረት ከእጀታው ይወልቃል። ብረቱም ሌላውን መትቶ ይገድለዋል። መጥረቢያውን የሰነዘረው ሰው ከእነዚህ ከተሞች ወደ አንዱ ሸሽቶ በሕይወት ሊኖር ይችላል።

hi.L: जैसे कोई अपने पड़ोसी के साथ लकड़ी काटने जंगल में जाए, और पेड़ काटने के लिए कुल्हाड़ी के साथ उसका हाथ चले, और लोहा लकड़ी से निकलकर उसके पड़ोसी को जा लगे, और वह मर जाए: वह इन नगरों में से किसी एक में भागकर जीवित रहे,
hi.B: उदाहरण के लिए, कोई अपने पड़ोसी के साथ लकड़ी काटने जंगल में जाता है। पेड़ काटने के लिए कुल्हाड़ी चलाते समय उसका फल बेंट से निकलकर पड़ोसी को जा लगता है, और वह मर जाता है। तब काटनेवाला इन नगरों में से किसी एक में भागकर जीवित रह सकता है,
hi.R: मान लो कि दो पड़ोसी लकड़ी काटने जंगल में जाते हैं। उनमें से एक पेड़ काटने के लिए कुल्हाड़ी चलाता है, पर कुल्हाड़ी का फल बेंट से निकल जाता है। वह दूसरे को लगता है, और वह मर जाता है। तब कुल्हाड़ी चलानेवाला भागकर इनमें से किसी एक नगर में जा सकता है और जीवित रह सकता है।

ru.L: Как если кто пойдёт со своим ближним в лес рубить дрова, и размахнётся его рука топором, чтобы срубить дерево, и соскочит железо с топорища, и попадёт в его ближнего, и тот умрёт, — он пусть убежит в один из этих городов и останется жив,
ru.B: Например, кто-то пошёл с ближним в лес рубить дрова. Когда он замахнулся топором, чтобы срубить дерево, топор соскочил с топорища и попал в ближнего, и тот умер. Тот, кто рубил, может убежать в один из этих городов и остаться в живых,
ru.R: Допустим, двое соседей пошли в лес рубить дрова. Один из них замахнулся топором, чтобы срубить дерево, но топор слетел с ручки. Он попал в другого, и тот умер. Тот, кто держал топор, может убежать в один из этих городов и остаться в живых.

ja.L: たとえば、人が木を切るために隣人と一緒に森に入り、木を切り倒そうとして斧を持つ手を振り下ろしたところ、鉄が木から抜けて隣人に当たり、彼が死んだ場合、その者はこれらの町の一つに逃げて生きることができる。
ja.B: たとえば、ある人が隣人と一緒に木を切りに森へ入り、木を切り倒そうと斧を振り下ろしたとき、斧の頭が柄から抜けて隣人に当たり、その人が死んだとする。木を切っていた者は、これらの町の一つに逃げて生き延びることができる。
ja.R: たとえば、二人の仲間が木を切りに森へ行ったとする。一人が木を切り倒そうとして斧を振ったが、斧の頭が柄から抜けてしまった。それがもう一人に当たって、その人は死んでしまった。斧を振った人は、これらの町の一つに逃げて、生き延びることができる。

uk.L: Як той, хто піде зі своїм ближнім у ліс рубати дрова, і його рука замахнеться сокирою, щоб зрубати дерево, і зісковзне залізо з держака і влучить у його ближнього, і той помре, — він утече до одного з цих міст і житиме,
uk.B: Наприклад, хтось іде з ближнім у ліс рубати дрова. Коли він замахується сокирою, щоб звалити дерево, лезо злітає з держака й влучає в ближнього, і той помирає. Той, хто рубав, може втекти до одного з цих міст і залишитися живим,
uk.R: Припустімо, двоє сусідів ідуть у ліс рубати дрова. Один із них замахується сокирою, щоб зрубати дерево, але лезо злітає з держака. Воно влучає в іншого, і той помирає. Той, хто замахнувся сокирою, може втекти до одного з цих міст і залишитися живим.

id.L: Misalnya seseorang pergi bersama-sama sesamanya ke hutan untuk menebang kayu, dan tangannya mengayunkan kapak untuk menebang pohon, lalu mata kapak itu terlepas dari gagangnya dan mengenai sesamanya itu, sehingga ia mati; orang itu boleh melarikan diri ke salah satu kota ini dan hidup,
id.B: Misalnya, seseorang pergi ke hutan bersama sesamanya untuk menebang kayu. Ketika ia mengayunkan kapak untuk menebang pohon, mata kapak itu terlepas dari gagangnya dan mengenai sesamanya itu sampai mati. Orang yang menebang itu boleh melarikan diri ke salah satu kota itu dan tetap hidup,
id.R: Misalnya, dua orang yang bertetangga pergi ke hutan untuk menebang kayu. Salah seorang dari mereka mengayunkan kapak untuk menebang pohon, tetapi mata kapak itu terlepas dari gagangnya. Mata kapak itu mengenai temannya, dan temannya itu mati. Orang yang mengayunkan kapak itu boleh melarikan diri ke salah satu kota itu dan tetap hidup.

zh.L: 比如，一个人和他的邻舍进树林去砍柴，他的手挥斧砍树，斧头从木柄上脱落，击中他的邻舍，以致他死了；这人可以逃到这些城中的一座去存活，
zh.B: 例如，有人和邻舍进树林砍柴，挥斧砍树的时候，斧头从柄上飞脱，打中了邻舍，邻舍就死了。那砍柴的人可以逃到这些城中的一座去保住性命，
zh.R: 比如，两个邻舍一起到树林里砍木头。其中一个挥斧砍树的时候，斧头从柄上掉了下来，打中了另一个人，那人就死了。挥斧的人可以逃到其中一座城里，保住性命。

tl.L: Gaya ng kapag ang isang tao ay pumasok sa gubat kasama ng kaniyang kapwa upang pumutol ng kahoy, at iniwasiwas ng kaniyang kamay ang palakol upang ibuwal ang punongkahoy, at nahulagpos ang bakal mula sa kahoy at tinamaan ang kaniyang kapwa, at ito ay namatay: tatakas siya sa isa sa mga lungsod na ito at mabubuhay,
tl.B: Halimbawa, may pumasok sa gubat kasama ng kaniyang kapwa upang pumutol ng kahoy. Habang iniwawasiwas niya ang palakol upang ibuwal ang isang punongkahoy, nahulagpos ang talim sa hawakan at tinamaan ang kaniyang kapwa, na namatay. Ang pumuputol ay maaaring tumakas sa isa sa mga lungsod na ito at manatiling buháy,
tl.R: Ipagpalagay na pumasok ang dalawang magkapitbahay sa gubat upang pumutol ng kahoy. Iniwasiwas ng isa ang palakol upang ibuwal ang isang punongkahoy, ngunit natanggal ang talim ng palakol sa hawakan nito. Tinamaan nito ang kasama niya, at namatay ito. Ang nagwasiwas ng palakol ay maaaring tumakas sa isa sa mga bayang ito at manatiling buháy.

pa.L: ਜਿਵੇਂ ਜਦ ਕੋਈ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਨਾਲ ਲੱਕੜਾਂ ਵੱਢਣ ਲਈ ਜੰਗਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਵੇ, ਅਤੇ ਰੁੱਖ ਵੱਢਣ ਲਈ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਹੱਥ ਕੁਹਾੜੀ ਨਾਲ ਝੂਲੇ, ਅਤੇ ਲੋਹਾ ਦਸਤੇ ਤੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਨੂੰ ਜਾ ਲੱਗੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਮਰ ਜਾਵੇ: ਉਹ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੱਜ ਜਾਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਜੀਉਂਦਾ ਰਹੇ,
pa.B: ਮਿਸਾਲ ਵਜੋਂ, ਕੋਈ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਨਾਲ ਜੰਗਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੱਕੜਾਂ ਕੱਟਣ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਰੁੱਖ ਡੇਗਣ ਲਈ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਚਲਾਉਂਦਿਆਂ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਫਲ ਦਸਤੇ ਤੋਂ ਲੱਥ ਕੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਨੂੰ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਮਰ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਲੱਕੜ ਕੱਟਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੱਜ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਾਨ ਬਚਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ,
pa.R: ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਦੋ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਜੰਗਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੱਕੜਾਂ ਕੱਟਣ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਇੱਕ ਜਣਾ ਰੁੱਖ ਕੱਟਣ ਲਈ ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਮਾਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਕੁਹਾੜੇ ਦਾ ਲੋਹਾ ਦਸਤੇ ਤੋਂ ਨਿੱਕਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਉਹ ਦੂਜੇ ਨੂੰ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਉਹ ਮਰ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਕੁਹਾੜਾ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਗਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੱਜ ਕੇ ਬਚ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

decisions.choice: and one who: an example of a killing without knowledge
decisions.reason: The verse gives a case that fits the rule of verse 4: two people at work together, and a death no one intended.

decisions.choice: his hand is driven with the ax: he swings the ax hard
decisions.reason: The verb means to be pushed or driven. The picture is of the full swing of the arm as the ax comes down on the tree.

decisions.choice: the iron slips from the wood: the ax head comes off its wooden handle
alternatives: the iron glances off the tree
decisions.reason: "The iron" is the head of the ax, and "the wood" most likely its handle. The same word was just used for the tree being cut, so the words could also mean that the iron glances off the tree, or that a chip flies from it, but the head flying off the handle is the plainest sense.

decisions.choice: finds his neighbor: hits him
decisions.reason: To "find" here is to reach or strike, as an arrow or a blow finds its mark. It stresses that the blow was not aimed at him.

decisions.choice: the head ... the handle
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the parts of the ax, so the picture is clear. Literal keeps "the iron" and "the wood". Balanced and Literal end the verse with a comma, since verse 6 gives the reason for the rule.

decisions.choice: o ferro ... da madeira (L); o ferro ... do cabo (B, R); alcançar (L), atingir (B, R)
decisions.reason: Portuguese calls the iron head of an ax "o ferro", so Balanced and Readable can keep the Hebrew word and only name the handle, "o cabo" (m3). Literal says "alcançar" for "find", a verb that can also mean to reach a target (m4); Balanced and Readable say "atingir".

decisions.choice: 斧头从木柄上脱落
decisions.reason: "The iron slips from the wood" (m3) is the ax head coming off its handle. Literal names the parts with "斧头" and "木柄", keeping the wood in "木", since the bare "铁" and "木头" would read as the tree.

decisions.choice: "Gaya ng kapag" (L); "Halimbawa" (B); "Ipagpalagay na" (R)
decisions.reason: An example of a killing without knowledge (m1).

decisions.choice: "iniwasiwas ng kaniyang kamay ang palakol"
decisions.reason: He swings the ax hard (m2).

decisions.choice: "nahulagpos ang bakal mula sa kahoy" (L); "ang talim sa hawakan" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The ax head comes off its wooden handle (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "tinamaan"
decisions.reason: Hits him (m4).

source.text: פֶּן־יִרְדֹּף֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל הַדָּ֜ם אַחֲרֵ֣י הָרֹצֵ֗חַ כִּי־יֵחַם֮ לְבָבוֹ֒ וְהִשִּׂיג֛וֹ כִּֽי־יִרְבֶּ֥ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ וְהִכָּ֣הוּ נָ֑פֶשׁ וְלוֹ֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁפַּט־מָ֔וֶת כִּ֠י לֹ֣א שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: lest pursue the avenger of the blood after the killer, for is hot his heart, and overtake him, for is long the way, and strike him [as to] life; and to him not [is a] sentence of death, for not hating he [was] him from yesterday [and the] third day.

en.L: lest the avenger of blood pursue the killer while his heart is hot, and overtake him because the way is long, and strike him dead; and for him [there is] no sentence of death, since he was not hating him in time past.
en.B: or else the avenger of blood, in the heat of anger, might chase the killer, catch up because the way is long, and kill {{gender:them|him}}. Yet that person did not deserve to die, having had no hatred for the dead neighbor before.
en.R: If the town is too far away, the relative who avenges the death might chase the killer in a rage, catch up and kill {{gender:them|him}}. But the killer did not deserve to die, because the killer had not hated the person who died.

es.L: no sea que el vengador de la sangre persiga al homicida mientras su corazón está enardecido, y lo alcance porque el camino es largo, y lo hiera de muerte; y no [hay] para él sentencia de muerte, pues no lo odiaba en tiempo pasado.
es.B: de lo contrario, el vengador de la sangre, en el ardor de su ira, podría perseguir al que mató, alcanzarlo porque el camino es largo y matarlo. Sin embargo, esa persona no merecía morir, pues antes no tenía ningún odio contra el prójimo que murió.
es.R: Si la ciudad está demasiado lejos, el pariente que venga la muerte podría perseguir con furia al que mató, alcanzarlo y matarlo. Pero el que mató no merecía morir, porque no odiaba a la persona que murió.

fr.L: de peur que le vengeur du sang ne poursuive le meurtrier tandis que son cœur est échauffé, ne l’atteigne parce que le chemin est long, et ne le frappe à mort ; or il n’y a pas pour lui de sentence de mort, puisqu’il ne le haïssait pas auparavant.
fr.B: sinon le vengeur du sang, dans le feu de la colère, pourrait poursuivre celui qui a tué, le rattraper parce que le chemin est long, et le tuer. Pourtant cette personne ne méritait pas la mort, puisqu’elle n’avait aucune haine auparavant pour le prochain qui est mort.
fr.R: Si la ville est trop loin, le parent qui venge le mort pourrait poursuivre dans sa colère celui qui a tué, le rattraper et le tuer. Mais celui qui a tué ne méritait pas de mourir, car il ne détestait pas la personne qui est morte.

sw.L: mlipiza kisasi wa damu asije akamfuatia mwuaji moyo wake ukiwa na hasira kali, akampata kwa sababu njia ni ndefu, akampiga hata akafa; wala kwake hakuna hukumu ya kifo, kwa kuwa hakuwa akimchukia tangu zamani.
sw.B: la sivyo mlipiza kisasi wa damu, akiwa amewaka hasira, angeweza kumfuatia mtu aliyeua, kumpata kwa sababu njia ni ndefu, na kumwua. Lakini mtu huyo hakustahili kufa, kwa kuwa hakuwa na chuki dhidi ya jirani aliyekufa hapo kabla.
sw.R: Ikiwa mji uko mbali sana, ndugu anayelipiza kisasi angeweza kumfuatia kwa hasira mtu aliyeua, akampata na kumwua. Lakini mtu aliyeua hakustahili kufa, kwa sababu hakuwa amemchukia yule aliyekufa.

vi.L: kẻo người báo thù máu, khi lòng đang nóng giận, đuổi theo kẻ giết người, và bắt kịp vì đường xa, và đánh chết người ấy; dù người ấy không đáng [án] tử, vì trước đây người ấy không ghét người kia.
vi.B: kẻo người báo thù máu, trong cơn giận, đuổi theo kẻ giết người, bắt kịp vì đường quá xa và giết người ấy, dù người ấy không đáng chết, vì trước đó không hề thù ghét người đã chết.
vi.R: Nếu thành ở quá xa, người bà con báo thù cho người chết có thể giận dữ đuổi theo kẻ giết người, bắt kịp và giết người ấy. Nhưng người ấy không đáng chết, vì trước đó không hề ghét người đã chết.

ko.L: 그것은 피의 보복자가 마음이 뜨거워져 살인자를 뒤쫓다가, 길이 멀어서 그를 따라잡아 목숨을 치지 않게 하려는 것이다. 그는 전에 그를 미워하지 않았으므로 그에게는 죽을 죄가 없다.
ko.B: 그렇지 않으면 피의 보복자가 화가 치밀어 그 사람을 뒤쫓다가, 길이 멀어서 따라잡아 죽일지도 모른다. 그러나 그 사람은 전에 죽은 이웃을 미워한 일이 없으므로 죽어 마땅한 사람이 아니다.
ko.R: 성읍이 너무 멀면, 죽은 사람의 원수를 갚으려는 친척이 몹시 화가 나서 그 사람을 뒤쫓아 가 따라잡고 죽일지도 모릅니다. 그러나 그 사람은 죽은 사람을 미워한 적이 없으므로 죽어서는 안 될 사람입니다.

pt.L: para que o vingador do sangue não persiga o homicida enquanto o seu coração está quente, e o alcance, porque o caminho é longo, e o fira mortalmente; e para ele não [há] sentença de morte, pois ele não o odiava no passado.
pt.B: Do contrário, o vingador do sangue, no calor da raiva, poderia perseguir quem matou e alcançá-lo, porque o caminho é longo, e matá-lo. Mas quem matou não merecia a morte, pois antes não tinha ódio do morto.
pt.R: Se a cidade ficar longe demais, o parente que vinga a morte pode perseguir quem matou, cheio de raiva, alcançar essa pessoa e matá-la. Mas essa pessoa não merecia morrer, porque não odiava quem morreu.

am.L: የደም ተበቃዩ ልቡ ሲግል ገዳዩን እንዳያሳድደው፣ መንገዱም ረጅም ስለ ሆነ እንዳይደርስበትና ነፍሱን እንዳይመታው፤ ለእርሱም የሞት ፍርድ የለበትም፤ ከትናንትና ከትናንት ወዲያ አልጠላውምና።
am.B: አለዚያ የደም ተበቃዩ በቁጣ ተነሣሥቶ ሰው የገደለውን ያሳድደዋል፤ መንገዱም ረጅም ስለ ሆነ ደርሶበት ይገድለዋል። ያ ሰው ግን የሞተውን ባልንጀራውን ቀድሞ ስላልጠላው ሞት አይገባውም ነበር።
am.R: ከተማው በጣም ሩቅ ከሆነ የሟቹን ደም የሚበቀለው ዘመድ በቁጣ ሰው የገደለውን ያሳድደው ይሆናል፤ ደርሶበትም ይገድለው ይሆናል። ነገር ግን ሰው የገደለው የሞተውን ሰው ስላልጠላው መሞት አይገባውም ነበር።

hi.L: कहीं ऐसा न हो कि ख़ून का बदला लेनेवाला अपने मन के गरम होने के कारण मारनेवाले का पीछा करे, और मार्ग लंबा होने के कारण उसे जा पकड़े और उसे जान से मार डाले; जबकि वह मृत्यु-दंड के योग्य न था, क्योंकि वह पहले से उससे बैर न रखता था।
hi.B: नहीं तो ख़ून का बदला लेनेवाला क्रोध के आवेश में मारनेवाले का पीछा करे, और मार्ग लंबा होने के कारण उसे पकड़कर मार डाले, जबकि वह व्यक्ति मरने के योग्य न था, क्योंकि वह पहले से मरे हुए पड़ोसी से बैर न रखता था।
hi.R: यदि नगर बहुत दूर हो, तो मौत का बदला लेनेवाला रिश्तेदार ग़ुस्से में आकर मारनेवाले का पीछा करे, उसे पकड़ ले और मार डाले। पर मारनेवाला मरने के योग्य न था, क्योंकि उसने मरनेवाले से बैर नहीं रखा था।

ru.L: чтобы не погнался выкупщик крови за убийцей, пока горячо его сердце, и не настиг его, потому что длинна дорога, и не убил его; а ему не положен смертный приговор, потому что он не ненавидел его ни вчера, ни третьего дня.
ru.B: иначе мститель за кровь в пылу гнева может погнаться за убийцей, настичь его, потому что путь долог, и убить его. А ведь этот человек не заслуживал смерти, потому что прежде не питал ненависти к убитому.
ru.R: Если город будет слишком далеко, родственник, который мстит за убитого, может в ярости погнаться за убийцей, догнать и убить его. Но убийца не заслуживал смерти, потому что не испытывал ненависти к тому, кто погиб.

ja.L: 血の復讐をする者が、心が熱くなって、人を殺した者の後を追い、道が遠いために追いつき、彼を打って命を奪うことのないためである。彼には死の判決はない。彼は昨日もおとといも、その人を憎んでいなかったからである。
ja.B: そうでないと、血の復讐をする者が怒りに燃えて、人を殺した者を追いかけ、道が遠いために追いついて、殺してしまうかもしれない。しかしその人は、以前から相手を憎んでいたわけではないので、死に値しないのである。
ja.R: 町が遠すぎると、死んだ人の家族で仇を討つ人が、かっとなって、人を殺してしまった人を追いかけ、追いついて殺してしまうかもしれない。けれども、その人は死ななければならないわけではない。死んだ人を、それまで憎んではいなかったからである。

uk.L: щоб месник за кров не погнався за вбивцею, поки палає його серце, і не наздогнав його, бо дорога довга, і не вбив його; а йому не належить смертний вирок, бо він не ненавидів його ні вчора, ні позавчора.
uk.B: інакше месник за кров у запалі гніву може погнатися за вбивцею, наздогнати, бо дорога довга, і вбити {{gender:цю людину|його}}. Але {{gender:та людина не заслуговувала|той не заслуговував}} на смерть, бо раніше не мав ненависті до померлого ближнього.
uk.R: Якщо місто задалеко, родич, що мститься за смерть, може в люті погнатися за вбивцею, наздогнати й убити {{gender:цю людину|його}}. Але вбивця не заслуговував на смерть, бо не ненавидів того, хто помер.

id.L: supaya penuntut balas darah, karena hatinya panas, jangan mengejar pembunuh itu dan menyusulnya karena jalannya jauh, dan membunuhnya, padahal ia tidak patut dihukum mati, sebab ia tidak membenci orang itu sejak kemarin dan kemarin dulu.
id.B: supaya penuntut balas darah, dalam panasnya amarah, tidak mengejar pembunuh itu, menyusulnya karena jalannya jauh, dan membunuhnya. Padahal orang itu tidak patut dihukum mati, sebab sebelumnya ia tidak membenci orang yang mati itu.
id.R: Jika kota itu terlalu jauh, kerabat yang membalas kematian itu mungkin mengejar pembunuh itu dengan marah, menyusulnya, dan membunuhnya. Padahal pembunuh itu tidak patut mati, karena ia tidak membenci orang yang mati itu.

zh.L: 免得报血仇的人心中火热，追赶那杀人的，因路途遥远就追上他，把他打死；其实他不该被判死罪，因为他从前与死者并无仇恨。
zh.B: 否则报血仇的人怒火中烧，就可能追赶那杀了人的人，因路途遥远而追上，把这人杀死。其实这人不该死，因为他以前对死去的邻舍并没有仇恨。
zh.R: 如果城离得太远，为死者报仇的亲人可能会怒气冲冲地追赶那杀了人的人，追上了就把这人杀死。可是这人并不该死，因为他以前并不恨那个死去的人。

tl.L: baka habulin ng tagapaghiganti ng dugo ang nakapatay habang mainit ang kaniyang puso, at abutan siya dahil malayo ang daan, at patayin siya; gayong sa kaniya ay walang hatol na kamatayan, yamang hindi niya ito kinapopootan noong nakaraan.
tl.B: kung hindi ay baka habulin ng tagapaghiganti ng dugo ang nakapatay sa tindi ng galit, abutan siya dahil malayo ang daan, at patayin siya. Gayong hindi dapat mamatay ang taong iyon, sapagkat wala siyang galit sa namatay na kapwa noon.
tl.R: Kung napakalayo ng bayan, baka habulin ng kamag-anak na naghihiganti sa pagkamatay ang nakapatay habang galit na galit siya, abutan ito, at patayin. Ngunit hindi dapat mamatay ang nakapatay, sapagkat hindi niya kinapootan ang taong namatay.

pa.L: ਕਿਤੇ ਅਜਿਹਾ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਕਿ ਖ਼ੂਨ ਦਾ ਬਦਲਾ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲਾ, ਜਦ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਦਿਲ ਗਰਮ ਹੋਵੇ, ਖ਼ੂਨੀ ਦਾ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕਰੇ, ਅਤੇ ਰਾਹ ਲੰਮਾ ਹੋਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਜਾ ਫੜੇ, ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰ ਸੁੱਟੇ; ਪਰ ਉਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਮੌਤ ਦਾ ਦੋਸ਼ ਨਹੀਂ [ਸੀ], ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਉਹ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਵੈਰ ਨਾ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਸੀ।
pa.B: ਨਹੀਂ ਤਾਂ ਖ਼ੂਨ ਦਾ ਬਦਲਾ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਗੁੱਸੇ ਦੀ ਅੱਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਖ਼ੂਨੀ ਦਾ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ, ਰਾਹ ਲੰਮਾ ਹੋਣ ਕਰਕੇ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਫੜ ਲਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਰ ਦੇਵੇ। ਪਰ ਉਹ ਬੰਦਾ ਮੌਤ ਦੇ ਲਾਇਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਮਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਨਾਲ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੋਈ ਵੈਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ।
pa.R: ਜੇ ਨਗਰ ਬਹੁਤ ਦੂਰ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਾਂ ਮਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਦਾ ਉਹ ਰਿਸ਼ਤੇਦਾਰ ਜਿਹੜਾ ਮੌਤ ਦਾ ਬਦਲਾ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਗੁੱਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਭੱਜ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਫੜ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪਰ ਮਾਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਮੌਤ ਦਾ ਹੱਕਦਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਉਸ ਨੇ ਮਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਨਾਲ ਕਦੇ ਨਫ਼ਰਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ ਕੀਤੀ।

decisions.choice: the avenger of blood: the dead person's near relative, who was to take life for life
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the relative who stands up for the family and buys back its land (Leviticus 25:25). When one of the family was killed, this relative was bound to pursue the killer (Numbers 35:12, 19).

decisions.choice: his heart is hot: in the heat of anger
decisions.reason: A "hot heart" is rage. The relative's anger would not wait to ask whether the killing was an accident.

decisions.choice: because the way is long: the reason for verses 2-3
decisions.reason: If the city is far off, the killer may be caught before reaching it. This is why the land is divided into three and the roads made ready.

decisions.choice: strike him in life: kill him
decisions.reason: To strike someone "as to the life" is to deal a deadly blow (verse 11; Genesis 37:21).

decisions.choice: for him there is no sentence of death: he does not deserve to die
decisions.reason: The killing was not murder, so the law does not condemn the killer to death. If the avenger killed him, an innocent life would be taken (verse 10).

decisions.choice: If the town is too far away
decisions.reason: Readable puts "because the way is long" first, as a plain condition, so the reason for the rule is clear.

decisions.choice: them / him
decisions.reason: The killer may be a man or a woman, so Balanced and Readable use the gender setting for the pronoun. Readable repeats "the killer" rather than use a pronoun with a verb that would change with the setting.

decisions.choice: "alcanzarlo ... matarlo", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English has a gender setting for "them|him", the Spanish pronoun refers back to "el que mató", which already means anyone who killed; generic "lo" needs no alternative wording. The same holds in verses 12-13.

decisions.choice: "le rattraper ... le tuer", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English has a gender setting for "them|him", the French pronoun refers back to "celui qui a tué", which already means anyone who killed; generic "le" needs no alternative wording. The same holds in verses 12-13.

decisions.choice: "người báo thù máu" (L, B); "người bà con báo thù cho người chết" (R)
decisions.reason: The dead person's near relative, who was to take life for life (meaning decision). Blood is "máu" everywhere in these books as settled; Joshua 20 still has "huyết" and should follow when it is revised.

decisions.choice: "피의 보복자" (Literal, Balanced), "죽은 사람의 원수를 갚으려는 친척" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As Joshua 20 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "그 사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "그 사람" already covers a man or a woman, so the English "them | him" setting has nothing to change in Korean; the same holds through Deuteronomy 16-25.

decisions.choice: o vingador do sangue (L, B); o parente que vinga a morte (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as Numbers 35:12 and 19 have it in Portuguese: the near relative bound to answer for a life (m1) is "o vingador do sangue" at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says who he is, "o parente que vinga a morte", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: no gender setting (verses 6, 12, 13)
alternatives: a gender setting on the pronoun
decisions.reason: The English needs a gender setting for the pronouns that refer to the killer ("them|him"). Portuguese refers back to "quem matou", "essa pessoa" or "o assassino", which already cover a man or a woman, and the pronoun agrees with that word ("-lo", "-la", "dele"), as Numbers 35:19 does in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "the avenger of blood" as "የደም ተበቃዩ" (L, B); "የሟቹን ደም የሚበቀለው ዘመድ" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the Amharic Numbers 35: "ተበቃይ" is the one who takes revenge, and with "ደም" it names the dead person's kinsman; Readable spells out that he is a relative, as the English Readable does. Also in verse 12.

decisions.choice: no gender span on the object suffix of "ይገድለዋል", "ይገድለው" and the like
decisions.reason: The English offers "them" or "him". The Amharic masculine object suffix is the generic form for anyone, so the Amharic has no gender span (also verses 12-13), as in Numbers 35.

decisions.choice: "ख़ून का बदला लेनेवाला" (L, B); "मौत का बदला लेनेवाला रिश्तेदार" (R)
decisions.reason: The avenger of blood is the dead person's near relative (m1). Hindi keeps the words of Numbers 35. The killer may be a man or a woman, and Hindi "उसे" does not show gender, so the English span on "them/him" has nothing to change in Hindi; the same in verses 12-13.

decisions.choice: "выкупщик крови" (L); "мститель за кровь" (B); "родственник, который мстит за убитого" (R)
decisions.reason: The goʾel ha-dam is the dead person's near relative, who was to take life for life (m1). Literal keeps the word "выкупщик" that the Pentateuch uses for goʾel (Leviticus 25), so a reader sees it is the same kinsman's duty; Balanced and Readable say what he does here.

decisions.choice: "его" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Russian "его" here agrees with "убийца" and "этот человек", which may be a man or a woman, so no gender span is needed (19:6, 19:12-13), as the style guide says for "человек".

decisions.choice: go'el haddam "血の復讐をする者" (L, B), "死んだ人の家族で仇を討つ人" (R)
decisions.reason: The near relative whose duty was life for life; Readable says who he is.

decisions.choice: No gender span for {{gender:them|him}}; the object is left unspoken or "その人"
decisions.reason: Japanese needs no pronoun here, so the English span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: "месник за кров" (L, B), "родич, що мститься за смерть" (R)
decisions.reason: The avenger is the dead person's near relative; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew phrase, Readable says who he is.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:цю людину|його}}"
decisions.reason: As in 13:9: Ukrainian has no neutral "them" for one person, so the inclusive option says "ця людина" and agrees with it.

decisions.choice: 报血仇的人 (L, B), 为死者报仇的亲人 (R)
decisions.reason: The go'el haddam (m1), the near relative who was to take life for life. One form per level through chapters 19-21.

decisions.choice: 这人 (no gender span)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable have a gender span for "them / him", since the killer may be a man or a woman. Chinese says "这人", which is already inclusive, and needs no span; the same through verses 12-13.

decisions.choice: "tagapaghiganti ng dugo" (L, B); "kamag-anak na naghihiganti sa pagkamatay" (R)
decisions.reason: The dead person's near relative, who was to take life for life (m1); wording as at Numbers 35.

decisions.choice: "habang mainit ang kaniyang puso" (L); "sa tindi ng galit" (B); "galit na galit" (R)
decisions.reason: In the heat of anger (m2).

decisions.choice: "dahil malayo ang daan"; "Kung napakalayo ng bayan" (R)
decisions.reason: The reason for verses 2-3 (m3), as English (en1).

decisions.choice: "patayin siya"
decisions.reason: Kill him (m4).
